benefit_value_chk.name: benefit_value_chk
benefit_value_chk.value: ("benefit"."value_amount" is null) = ("benefit"."value_currency" is null) and ("benefit"."value_amount" is null) = ("benefit"."value_unit_scale" is null) and coalesce("benefit"."value_unit_scale", 1) in (1, 1000, 1000000)

benefit_realized_money_chk.name: benefit_realized_money_chk
benefit_realized_money_chk.value: ("benefit"."realized_amount" is null) = ("benefit"."realized_currency" is null) and ("benefit"."realized_amount" is null) = ("benefit"."realized_unit_scale" is null) and coalesce("benefit"."realized_unit_scale", 1) in (1, 1000, 1000000)

benefit_realized_chk.name: benefit_realized_chk
benefit_realized_chk.value: "benefit"."status" not in ('realized_unverified', 'realized_verified') or (nullif(btrim("benefit"."verification_source"), '') is not null and "benefit"."realization_recorded_by" is not null and "benefit"."realized_on" is not null)

benefit_verified_chk.name: benefit_verified_chk
benefit_verified_chk.value: "benefit"."status" <> 'realized_verified' or ("benefit"."verified_by" is not null and "benefit"."verified_at" is not null and "benefit"."verified_by" <> "benefit"."realization_recorded_by" and "benefit"."verified_by" is distinct from "benefit"."owner_user_id")

budget_line_approved_chk.name: budget_line_approved_chk
budget_line_approved_chk.value: "budget_line"."approved_amount" is null or ("budget_line"."approval_decision_id" is not null and "budget_line"."approved_by" is not null and "budget_line"."approved_at" is not null and "budget_line"."approval_state" = 'approved')

financial_model_source_chk.name: financial_model_source_chk
financial_model_source_chk.value: "financial_model_version"."source_document_id" is not null or nullif(btrim("financial_model_version"."source_ref"), '') is not null

financial_model_validator_chk.name: financial_model_validator_chk
financial_model_validator_chk.value: "financial_model_version"."validated_by" is null or ("financial_model_version"."validated_by" is distinct from "financial_model_version"."prepared_by" and "financial_model_version"."validated_hash" is not null and "financial_model_version"."validated_at" is not null)

financial_model_approved_values_chk.name: financial_model_approved_values_chk
financial_model_approved_values_chk.value: "financial_model_version"."approved_values" is null or ("financial_model_version"."approval_state" = 'approved' and "financial_model_version"."approval_decision_id" is not null and "financial_model_version"."approved_by" is not null and "financial_model_version"."validated_by" is not null and "financial_model_version"."approved_by" <> "financial_model_version"."validated_by")

financial_snapshot_source_chk.name: financial_snapshot_source_chk
financial_snapshot_source_chk.value: "financial_snapshot"."source_document_id" is not null or nullif(btrim("financial_snapshot"."source_ref"), '') is not null

financial_snapshot_import_ref_chk.name: financial_snapshot_import_ref_chk
financial_snapshot_import_ref_chk.value: "financial_snapshot"."source_type" not in ('excel', 'csv') or ("financial_snapshot"."source_document_id" is not null and "financial_snapshot"."source_cell" is not null and ("financial_snapshot"."source_type" = 'csv' or "financial_snapshot"."source_sheet" is not null))

financial_snapshot_validator_chk.name: financial_snapshot_validator_chk
financial_snapshot_validator_chk.value: "financial_snapshot"."validated_by" is null or ("financial_snapshot"."validated_by" is distinct from "financial_snapshot"."prepared_by" and "financial_snapshot"."validated_hash" is not null and "financial_snapshot"."validated_at" is not null)

financial_snapshot_approved_chk.name: financial_snapshot_approved_chk
financial_snapshot_approved_chk.value: "financial_snapshot"."approval_state" <> 'approved' or ("financial_snapshot"."validated_by" is not null and "financial_snapshot"."approved_by" is not null and "financial_snapshot"."approved_at" is not null and "financial_snapshot"."approved_by" <> "financial_snapshot"."validated_by" and "financial_snapshot"."approved_by" is distinct from "financial_snapshot"."prepared_by")

intercompany_reconciliation_reconciled_c.name: intercompany_reconciliation_reconciled_chk
intercompany_reconciliation_reconciled_c.value: "intercompany_reconciliation"."status" <> 'reconciled' or ("intercompany_reconciliation"."their_balance" is not null and "intercompany_reconciliation"."reviewer_user_id" is not null and "intercompany_reconciliation"."reviewed_at" is not null and "intercompany_reconciliation"."reviewer_user_id" is distinct from "intercompany_reconciliation"."prepared_by" and ("intercompany_reconciliation"."their_balance" = "intercompany_reconciliation"."our_balance" or nullif(btrim("intercompany_reconciliation"."explanation"), '') is not null))
